title: Add stage graph job failure semantics

context.summary: Expose document pipeline stage graph semantics through processing jobs and job APIs.
context.background: The multimodal router can skip disabled stages and workers can partially proceed, but job records still expose only coarse pending/running/succeeded/failed states.

in: Add core job status/details contracts for skipped, disabled, blocked_by_scan, partial_failed, retry and per-stage progress.
Update job store mapping and API responses to expose readable stage graph status, progress and errors without changing raw originals.
Update worker route/extract/chunk/embed/index paths to record skipped/disabled/blocking/partial failure semantics in job metadata.
Preserve existing queue retry behavior while making retryable errors explicit in job details.
Add integration or validator coverage for skipped/disabled stages and readable failed job details.
Update jobs and document pipeline docs.
out: New CLI, MCP or Hermes job command surfaces.
Adding a new durable workflow engine.

acceptance_criteria: Jobs API exposes stage graph status details for skipped, disabled, blocked_by_scan and partial_failed outcomes.
Job responses include per-stage progress metadata when processors record it.
Failed jobs expose readable error codes/messages and retryability metadata.
Disabled handlers are represented as skipped/disabled stage details rather than silent success.
Existing job retry API remains compatible.

manual_checks: Confirm jobs API responses include stage graph details and readable errors.

risks: The existing jobs table status enum stays coarse; stage graph semantics must fit metadata without schema churn.
Partial failure semantics need to be informative without pretending a non-blocking skipped stage is a hard failure.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
